settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account settings and Nostr identity

nostr.title: Login Info
nostr.description: Your decentralized identity on the Nostr network. Keep your private key secure!

publicKey.description: This is your public identity on Nostr. Safe to share publicly.

privateKey.warning: ⚠️ Keep this private! Never share your private key with anyone.
privateKey.alby: ℹ️ Your private key is securely managed by the Alby extension and cannot be accessed directly.
privateKey.managed: Private key managed by Alby extension

qrCode.title: Login QR Code
qrCode.description: Scan this QR code on another device to log in instantly.

security.title: Security Reminder
security.description: Your private key (nsec) gives full control over your Nostr identity. Store it safely and never share it with anyone.

recovery.title: Account Recovery
recovery.description: Set up email and password recovery to secure your account. This allows you to recover your account if you lose access to your primary login method.
recovery.generated_password_note: We've generated a secure, easy to remember password for you that you can use.
recovery.success: Account recovery has been set up successfully!

notice.title: Important:
notice.description: Your recovery email and password will be used to restore access to your account if you lose your primary authentication method. Keep them secure and accessible.

actions.title: Account Actions
actions.description: Manage your account settings and authentication.

modal.title: Delete Your Account
modal.wallet_loss: Your local wallet data, keys, and transaction history will be permanently lost and cannot be recovered.
modal.nostr_broadcast: A deletion request will be broadcast to Nostr relays immediately. Complete removal from all relays cannot be guaranteed due to the decentralized nature of the Nostr protocol.
modal.grace_period: Your account will enter a 30-day grace period. You can cancel the deletion at any time during this window simply by logging in again.
modal.permanent_deletion: If no login occurs within 30 days, your account will be permanently and irrecoverably deleted from BitTasker's systems.
modal.active_tasks_warning: Resolve any active contracts or open tasks before deleting.

delete_account.success: Your account has been scheduled for deletion. You have 30 days to log in and cancel.
delete_account.error: Failed to delete account. Please try again.

error.albyNotFound: Alby extension not found. Please ensure Alby is installed and enabled.
error.publicKeyAlby: Unable to get public key from Alby extension.
error.invalidPublicKey: Invalid public key format from Alby.
error.invalidNostrKeys: Invalid Nostr keys. Please refresh and try again.
error.noMnemonic: No mnemonic found. Please refresh and try again.
error.recoverySetup: Failed to setup account recovery. Please try again.

passkey.title: Passkey Sync
passkey.description: Set up a WebAuthn passkey to sync your biometric authentication across devices and browsers.
passkey.success: Passkey has been set up successfully!

error.setup: Failed to setup passkey. Please try again.
error.webauthn: WebAuthn is not available in this browser.
error.keys: Unable to retrieve biometric keys for passkey setup.

notice.title: About Passkeys:
notice.description: Passkeys allow you to authenticate using the same biometric data across different browsers and devices. Once set up, you can use this passkey to log in from other devices.

test.error: Passkey test failed. Please try again.

devices.description: Manage devices that have access to your account. You can revoke access from any device except the current one.
devices.cannotRevokeCurrentDevice: Cannot revoke access from current device

error.loadFailed: Failed to load devices. Please try again.
error.revokeFailed: Failed to revoke device access. Please try again.
error.revokeAllFailed: Failed to revoke all devices. Please try again.

revokeModal.title: Revoke Device Access
revokeModal.confirmMessage: This will permanently revoke access for
